name: Residual-current circuit breaker
summary: An RCCB operates on residual current and has no integral overcurrent protection.
description: An RCCB operates on residual current and has no integral overcurrent protection. The schematic needs both the sensing arrangement and the upstream or associated overcurrent protective device.
readingNotes: Follow all monitored live conductors through the residual-current measurement path.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: An RCBO also includes overcurrent protection; an RCCB does not.
